title: Truth found on sounds dancing on hymns of a dying leaf Just fade into broken silence of an evening wind while our moon rises on forgotten surprises tw
summary: Truth found on sounds dancing on hymns of a dying leaf Just fade into broken silence of an evening wind while our moon rises on forgotten surprises twisting in a long setting sun #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Truth
found on
  sounds dancing
on hymns
  of a
       dying leaf
Just fade into
     broken
  silence of
an evening wind
 while our
moon rises
  on forgotten surprises
twisting in
 a long
   setting
 sun
#smallpoems
